title: The Book of Three Worthies: Conclusion
paragraphs: _This is the end of the book, which has told in full detail the history of the Three Worthies of the Court of King Arthur._
_And now, if God will give me the grace to do it, I will write before very long the further history of several other knights and worthies whom I have not yet spoken of._

_The first of these will be Sir Launcelot, whom everyone knows to have been the greatest knight in feats of arms who ever lived, except for his son, Sir Galahad. I will also tell you the story of Sir Ewaine and Sir Geraint, of Sir Percival, and of several others._
_But that is for another time. For now, with great regret, I say farewell and bring this history to a close._
_May God allow us to meet again in such happiness and prosperity that your heart is free and untroubled, ready to enjoy the history of those excellent men that I will then set before you. Amen._
